description: codebase-kg advisory hook: a PostToolUse nudge on Edit/Write/MultiEdit that reminds you to run /codebase-kg:refresh — immediately when you edit a source file no node in knowledge/code_graph.db anchors on, and periodically once enough mapped files have changed. Never blocks, never edits. Honors .claude/codebase-kg.local.md (post_edit_nudge, nudge_every, root, graph_path); no-ops when the repo has no graph.
